m0-context.title: Load baseline context and verify handoff
m0-context.imperative: Read handoff at .agent-work/522-phase-align-utilization/crew-handoffs/g1-implement-handoff.md. Verify: task (discriminate (a)/(b) misregistration vs under-called caps), intent (physics-bounded U), scope (new files only in .agent-work), exclusions (no src/ writes), test mode (evidence-only), stop conditions (store unreachable, corners fail to load). Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: handoff complete; all fields verified; no missing fields

m0-context.result: Handoff is complete. Task: discriminate misregistration (a) vs under-called caps (b) using 2 RBR 2023-Q corners. Scope: .agent-work/ files only. Exclusions: no src/ writes. Test mode: evidence-only. Stop conditions: store unavailable or both corners fail.

m1-write-diag-script.title: Write reproducible diagnostic script diag_alignment.py
m1-write-diag-script.imperative: Write .agent-work/522-phase-align-utilization/diag_alignment.py using the exact seams from the handoff: EstimateStore, _build_ceiling, _load_lap_and_ribbon, PhysicsSimulator.simulate_lap, resample_by_progress, np.interp true-distance. Compute v_ideal, v_real_progress, v_real_truedist. Identify 2 corners on Monaco/VER: fast_corner apex + braking knee. Produce PNG figure. Write per-corner table to DIAGNOSIS.md.

postconditions.statement: diag_alignment.py exists at .agent-work/522-phase-align-utilization/ and is syntactically valid (py -m py_compile)

m2-run-diag.title: Run diagnostic script and collect outputs
m2-run-diag.imperative: Run: py .agent-work/522-phase-align-utilization/diag_alignment.py from repo root. Verify PNG(s) produced. Capture per-corner numbers (v_ideal_apex, v_real, curvature, progress-ratio, true-dist-ratio). If Monaco/VER fails, fall back to next RBR 2023-Q case in the store.

postconditions.statement: at least 1 PNG produced under .agent-work/522-phase-align-utilization/ and per-corner numbers in stdout

m3-write-diagnosis-md.title: Write DIAGNOSIS.md with verdict and evidence
m3-write-diagnosis-md.imperative: Write .agent-work/522-phase-align-utilization/DIAGNOSIS.md. Include: (a) or (b) verdict; per-corner table (v_ideal_apex m/s, v_real m/s, curvature 1/m, progress-ratio, true-dist-ratio); recommended comparison method; one-para rationale; any caveats.

preconditions.statement: diagnostic run complete with per-corner numbers

postconditions.statement: DIAGNOSIS.md exists and contains a verdict (a) or (b) plus a table

check.command: python -c "import os; c=open('.agent-work/522-phase-align-utilization/DIAGNOSIS.md').read(); assert 'verdict' in c.lower() or 'a)' in c or 'b)' in c, 'no verdict'

m4-write-result.imperative: Write .agent-work/522-phase-align-utilization/crew-handoffs/g1-implement-result.md using IMPLEMENTER_RESULT template.
